items.quote: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
items.claim: The servant raises concern that a woman may refuse to follow him to Abraham's land and asks whether he should return Abraham's son to his native land if she does
items.place: this land; the land from whence thou camest

items.quote: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
items.claim: Abraham commanded his servant not to bring his son back to his native land
items.object: the servant's bringing back of the son
